findings.body:
**Return a `baseTipSha` from the fixture's `readBaseRef`.**

`readBaseRef` returns only `baseRefName` at `test/ops/merge/runPrs.test.ts:169`. The resolver's publication path requires a base tip. It refuses when `base.baseTipSha` is undefined. The harness test at lines 1215-1217 expects an `acted` resolution. If the acted path reaches that check, the test can receive a refusal instead. Return a `baseTipSha` from the fixture. Keep it consistent with the fixture's second-parent and ancestry answers, so the gate accepts the resolution.
findings.title: Return a `baseTipSha` from the fixture's `readBaseRef`.

findings.body:
**Remove the full-run timing threshold.**

Line 2502 starts timing before scratch-directory creation and loop setup. Slow filesystem access or CI scheduling can exceed 200 ms even when the 20 ms governor signal fires correctly.

Remove this elapsed-time assertion. The `tripped` assertion and the exact wall-clock failure assertions already detect an unarmed governor.
findings.title: Remove the full-run timing threshold.

findings.body:
**Check `gitLog`, not `ghLog`, for withheld pushes.**

These six assertions pass `ghLog` to `gitLogPushes`. `fakeGit` records pushes in a separate `gitLog`, so these assertions pass even if publication occurs incorrectly.

Capture `gitLog` from each `runLoop` result and pass it to `gitLogPushes`.






Also applies to: 1698-1698, 1764-1764, 1789-1789, 1824-1824, 1886-1886
